# Experiments and how to reproduce them {#sec-experiments}

Every number in this book comes from one of the runs below. Paths are relative to the repository root. The steady
model is the Julia package in `steady/`, the TITAN port is in `julia/`, and the browser core is in `report/core/`.

## The steady model {#sec-exp-steady}

| experiment | command | output | chapter |
|---|---|---|---|
| opacity table (v2, the steady model's) | `cd steady && julia -t auto --project=. scripts/build_kap.jl` (~5 min on 2 cores) | `steady/output/kaptable_Z0_v2.jls` | @sec-opacity |
| extended table (TITAN infall) | `julia -t auto --project=. scripts/build_kap_ext.jl` (~13 min) | `kaptable_Z0_v3ext.jls` | @sec-opacity |
| validation without infall | `scripts/validate2.jl` | printed table | @sec-validation |
| grid of extended-branch solutions | `scripts/run_grid.jl` | `output/infall_grid.csv` | @sec-infall-diag |
| all roots, both branches | `scripts/branches.jl` | `output/branches.csv` | @sec-branches |
| fold refinement | `scripts/fold.jl` | `output/fold.csv` | @sec-branches |
| H₂ via H⁻ upper bounds | `scripts/h2_noneq.jl` | printed | @sec-h2 |
| profile for TITAN | `scripts/export_profile.jl 0.1 0 out.csv` | `reference_runs/qs_profile_f0.1_md0.csv` | @sec-titan-setup |
| reference values for the browser core | `scripts/export_reference.jl ../report/core/data` | `report/core/data/` | all ✓ badges |

## The browser core {#sec-exp-core}

`cd report && make test` runs the Rust validation suite that the ✓ badges link to; `make wasm` builds the
WebAssembly package used by the figures and the laboratory.

## TITAN {#sec-exp-titan}

| experiment | command (from `julia/`, with `TITAN_NOLIB=1`) | chapter |
|---|---|---|
| benchmarks SOD, SUBC, SUPC, pure Julia | `julia --project=env phase6_run.jl pure SUBC` | @sec-port-method |
| quasi-star set-up, no infall | `julia --project=env qstar_run.jl setup ../reference_runs/qs_profile_f0.1_md0.csv` | @sec-titan-setup |
| hydrostatic test (non-grey) | `julia --project=env qstar_run.jl relax 3e9 20000` | @sec-hydrostatic |
| hydrostatic test (grey) | `QS_GREY=1 QS_NAME=QSTAR_GREY` with `setup`, then `relax` | @sec-hydrostatic-surface |
| infall, Eulerian, ramped (run E1) | `Z0_TABLE=ext QS_NAME=E1 QS_MDOT=3e-3 QS_RAMP_FAC=100 QS_WCONTACT=1e-3` with `setup … 0.4 140 80`, then `QS_RAMP_FAC=100 QS_RAMP_T=2e6 … relax 1e8 20000` | @sec-titan-infall |
| infall, adaptive grid (run A1) | as E1 plus `QS_LGRID=1 QS_GRIDTAU=1e3` | @sec-titan-infall |
| Noh test of the artificial viscosity | `julia --project=env infall_tests.jl noh1d ql=2` (and `ql=0.2`, `mach=2000`, `lgrid=1`) | @sec-infall-defects |
| step-by-step diagnosis of a stalled run | `QS_SET=… julia --project=env stepdiag.jl STATE.tstate.gz NSTEPS`; Newton trace: `newtrace.jl STATE NSKIP NTRACE` | @sec-infall-defects |
| gas-only energy row vs TITAN's | `julia --project=env gasrow_check.jl SUBC` (and `SUPC`) | @sec-infall-defects |
| Compton relaxation box | `Z0_TABLE=ext STOL=0.01 julia --project=env compton_box.jl` | @sec-infall-defects |
| infall to 3 M⊙/yr (run R2) | `Z0_TABLE=ext QS_NAME=R2 QS_MDOT=3e-3 QS_RAMP_FAC=1000 QS_WCONTACT=1e-3 QS_ROUT=1.2` with `setup … 0.4 140 80`, then `Z0_TABLE=ext QS_NAME=R2 QS_SET=ql1=1e-4,cq2=1 QS_GASROW=1 QS_COMPTON=1 QS_RAMP_FAC=1000 QS_RAMP_T=2e6 QS_EVERY=50 … relax 6e7 200000`; continuation: `QS_NAME=R2c QS_INIT=R2 QS_FROM=STATE … relax 2.5e8` | @sec-infall-runs |
| resolution (runs R2H, R2L) | as R2 with `setup … 0.4 200 114` and `… 0.4 70 40` | @sec-infall-runs |
| run summaries | `Z0_TABLE=ext julia --project=env qstar_analyze.jl NAME [stride]` | @sec-infall-runs |
| inner mass sink (runs S6, S7) | as R2 plus `QS_SINK_TAU=1e6` (S7: `1e7`), `QS_INIT=R2`, `relax 1.2e8 400000` | @sec-infall-sink |
| order of the time integrators | `CONV=1e-10 Z0_TABLE=ext julia --project=env order_test.jl compton` (and `wave`; `radwave` with `NREF=16384 NLIST=256,512,1024,2048`); outputs in `reference_runs/order_test/` | @sec-infall-time |
| TR-BDF2 and Courant-capped runs (T2, K1) | as S6 plus `QS_TRBDF2=1` (`relax 4e7`), or `QS_CFL=1` | @sec-infall-time |
| adaptive continuation (AD1, AD2) | `julia --project=env to_adaptive.jl R2_t6e7.tstate.gz OUT 1e7 2,2,0 1,1e-2,0` (AD2: `1,1e-1,0`), then as R2 with `QS_FROM=OUT QS_INIT=R2 … relax 1.2e8` | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| finer adaptive run (R2AH, stalls at 2.5e7 s) | as R2A with `setup … 0.4 200 114` | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| adaptive runs at 220, 314, 440 zones (A220, A314, A440) | R2's `setup` with `QS_LGRID=1 QS_GRIDTAU=1e7 QS_LADY=2,2,0 QS_GRIDW=1,1e-2,0` and `0.4 140 80` / `0.4 200 114` / `0.4 280 160` (the last with `TITAN_MGR=500` for setup and run), then R2's `relax … 1.2e8` | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| long run (A220d; A220c, A220s) | `QS_FROM=A220 state QS_INIT=R2A QS_DTMAX=1e5 … relax 6e8` (A220c without the cap; A220s with `QS_SINK_TAU=1e6 QS_SINK_M0=4.205784e38`) | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| Courant-capped rerun (K2) | as K1 with the current code | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| adaptive run from the set-up (R2A) | R2's `setup` plus `QS_LGRID=1 QS_GRIDTAU=1e7 QS_LADY=2,2,0 QS_GRIDW=1,1e-2,0`, then R2's `relax … 1.2e8 600000` | @sec-infall-adaptive |
| spectra of TITAN snapshots | `Z0_TABLE=ext julia -t 2 --project=env spectra_run.jl RUN TIME ext=1 n=400 lucy=20 damp=0.5 nl=200 out=NAME` (A220 0 `ext=0` → `star_t0`; A220d 4.2e8 → `A220_late_ext`, with `ion=1` → `A220_late_ion`, `hotion=1` → `A220_late_hotion`, `ext=0` → `A220_late_noext`; A220 8e6 → `A220_corona_ext`); about 2–10 min each; output `lib/spectra/NAME.jls` | @sec-spec-infall |
| tests of the spectrum code | `julia -t 2 --project=env spectrum_test.jl` | @sec-spec-method |
| shock energy budget, column, line bounds | `Z0_TABLE=ext julia --project=env shock_budget.jl A220d 4.2e8` (and `R2 5.8e7`, `A220 8e6`) | @sec-spec-hot |
| Hα and Hβ of the infall | `Z0_TABLE=ext julia -t 2 --project=env line_profile.jl A220_late_ext` (`LP_NZ=9000`, `LP_XI=30` for the checks) | @sec-spec-lines |
| figure data | `julia --project=env export_report_data.jl bench`, `… qstar NAME`, `Z0_TABLE=ext … qstar R2+R2c`, `… qstar R2+AD1 PROFILE qstar_AD1.json`, `… qstar S6`, `… qstar A220+A220d PROFILE qstar_A220.json`, `… qstar A440`, `Z0_TABLE=ext … spectra star_t0 A220_late_ext A220_late_ion A220_late_hotion A220_late_noext A220_corona_ext` | figures |

The full engineering record of the port, with every check and its numbers, is
[`docs/PORTING_NOTES.md`](https://github.com/yipihey/titan.jl/blob/main/docs/PORTING_NOTES.md).
